class LegacyBlock(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.query_norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)
        self.memory_norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)
        self.cross_attention = nn.MultiheadAttention(256, 8, dropout=0.0, batch_first=True)
        self.ffn_norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)
        self.ffn = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(256,1024), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(1024,256))
    def forward(self, queries, memory, valid_mask):
        normalized_memory = self.memory_norm(memory)
        attended, _ = self.cross_attention(self.query_norm(queries), normalized_memory, normalized_memory, key_padding_mask=~valid_mask, need_weights=False)
        queries = queries + attended
        return queries + self.ffn(self.ffn_norm(queries))
class LegacyAdapter(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, qmax):
        super().__init__()
        self.qmax = qmax
        self.memory_projection = nn.Linear(1024,256)
        self.stereo_positions = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(2,256))
        self.query_positions = nn.Embedding(qmax,256)
        self.context_projection = nn.Linear(5120,256)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([LegacyBlock(), LegacyBlock()])
        self.output_norm = nn.LayerNorm(256)
        self.raw_output = nn.Linear(256,5120)
        self.length_head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(512,256), nn.GELU(), nn.Linear(256,1))
        nn.init.normal_(self.stereo_positions,std=0.02)
        nn.init.normal_(self.query_positions.weight,std=0.02)
    def forward(self, features, context, lengths):
        batch, _, frames, _ = features.shape
        valid = (torch.arange(frames)[None,None,:] < lengths[:,None,None]).expand(-1,2,-1)
        features = features.masked_fill(~valid[...,None],0)
        memory = self.memory_projection(features)
        memory = memory + self.stereo_positions[None,:,None,:]
        memory = memory + _position_encoding(frames,256,memory.device,memory.dtype)[None,None]
        memory = memory.flatten(1,2)
        mask = valid.flatten(1,2)
        context = self.context_projection(context)
        queries = self.query_positions.weight[None] + context[:,None]
        for block in self.blocks:
            queries = block(queries,memory,mask)
        raw = self.raw_output(self.output_norm(queries))
        summary = memory.masked_fill(~mask[...,None],0).sum(1) / mask.sum(1)[:,None]
        logs = self.length_head(torch.cat((summary,context),dim=-1)).squeeze(-1)
        return raw, logs
class FakeBackbone(nn.Module):
    backend = 'musicfm'
    hidden_size = 1024
    sample_rate = 24000
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.model = nn.Module()
        self.model.conv = nn.Linear(2,2)
        self.model.conformer = nn.Module()
        self.model.conformer.layer_norm = nn.LayerNorm(2)
        self.model.conformer.layers = nn.ModuleList([nn.Linear(2,2)])
        self.model.other = nn.Linear(2,2)
        self.model.stat = {'melspec_2048_mean':-5.0,'melspec_2048_std':2.0}
        self.model.register_buffer('running',torch.ones(2))
    def metadata(self):
        return {'backend':'musicfm','sample_rate':24000,'hidden_size':1024,'model_path':'fake'}
